description.p: Typecase is a quiet writing app for Markdown. Your texts live in a library of groups and sheets, stored as plain .md files in a folder of your choice — no database, no account, no network access.

ul.li: Markdown styled as you type, with a formatting bar for those who don't want to learn the syntax
Keywords, sheet properties and writing goals with progress rings
Export to PDF, Word and HTML with importable templates

screenshot.caption: A sheet in the editor, with the library and writing goals

description.p: Writing a longer work, and making the app your own.

ul.li: Group view: read and edit all sheets of a group as one continuous text
Your own order for sheets and groups, and duplicating them
Export a whole group as one document, optionally with each subgroup on a new page
Editor themes with light and dark variants; import your own
Spell checking while you type, in each sheet's language
Library of plain Markdown files in a folder of your choice, with groups, drag and drop, search and keywords
Live Markdown styling, formatting bar, find and replace
Focus mode with typewriter scrolling and dimmed surroundings
Sheet properties, writing goals and progress rings
Export to PDF, Word and HTML with importable templates
